summary: v0.8 adds portable frozen-input recovery and excludes local metadata/preferences; clean-like output matches v0.7 payload. Root built Web, WeChat and ByteDance targets successfully. Tech independently verified that each output differs from v0.7 only in generated main-script registration UUIDs and scope-resolved alias names, with normalized whole-script equality; bounded v0.7 runtime evidence can be associated, but v0.8 did not itself repeat the full 20-cycle IAB run.

acceptance_results.criterion: 先交轻量Brief与Tech对齐；正式输入为已批技术/视觉契约和83映射，当前代码只作同Client阶段内部实现，不冒称独立获批上游。
acceptance_results.evidence: 沿用v0.1已对齐Brief及批准输入；此版本只修复可复现生成器。

acceptance_results.criterion: 83资源经真实Creator导入并回读UUID，公开派生SpriteFrame.reset恢复原画布/offset，保持脚点、镜像、顺序、挂点、U05构图及动作时序；重复10组仅共享图片。
acceptance_results.evidence: Creator import geometry audit in Tech v0.30 records 82 logical rows, 72 image UUIDs and 419 production paths; v0.7 runtime sources are unchanged and v0.8 output equivalence supports bounded inheritance. See evidence/CREATOR_PORTABLE_BUILD_AND_EQUIVALENCE.json.

acceptance_results.criterion: 可复现发布输入仅保留启动菜单必需引用，本地world/游客/店铺/对话/奶茶明确唯一归属及依赖，原源图与其他任务脏文件不移动或覆盖，无CDN、降采样、删内容。
acceptance_results.evidence: Three platform builds passed; both native game.json files declare 8 local subpackages including the five business bundles. Pre-import payload comparison and actual Creator output counts/bytes are in BUILD_MANIFEST.json and BUNDLE_REPORT.json.

acceptance_results.criterion: 页面按需加载/离开释放及错误/取消/重入得到有效验证，实际HTTP产物同背景同尺度对照与循环证据可复核；非实测项明确NOT_TESTED。
acceptance_results.evidence: Root actual v0.7 lifecycle evidence is inherited only in Tech-approved bounded scope: all non-main outputs identical and main scripts normalize to strict equality after documented generated UUID/variable renaming. v0.8 itself did not repeat 20 cycles; direct v0.8 IAB is explicitly NOT_TESTED in OWNER_VERIFICATION.json.

acceptance_results.criterion: 准确源码、资产UUID/尺寸/偏移、构建依赖/物理包体与真实收益可追溯；平台构建能力据实尝试，超过限制交真实差额而不擅自降画质。
acceptance_results.evidence: Source/staging provenance, Creator-import geometry, three platform output inventories and physical output bytes are recorded in SOURCE_CHANGE_MANIFEST.json, RESOURCE_HANDOFF.json, BUNDLE_REPORT.json and BUILD_MANIFEST.json. GPU/device measurements remain NOT_TESTED.

risks: Root需用单独final副本重生成平台configs并检查Creator输出payload hashes；若不同，v0.7运行证据不可复用。
